title: FinOps War Room — AP/AR Command
tagline: Catch the coding error, duplicate payment, or fraud pattern before the check clears.
painPoint: AP/AR anomalies sit in a review queue for days, and by the time someone looks, the payment has already gone out.

steps.caption: The FinOps War Room
steps.talk: This is where AP/AR documents land the instant they're received — not three days later in someone's inbox.

steps.caption: Loading a live AP document
steps.talk: We're loading a real invoice — the kind that would normally sit waiting for a human to eyeball it.

steps.caption: Engines scan simultaneously
steps.talk: One click, and every engine — coding accuracy, duplicate-payment risk, fraud pattern, GL misclassification — scans this document at once.

steps.caption: Escalation bar lights up
steps.talk: The system already knows this needs a human decision — and it's already done the prep work for that decision.

steps.caption: Escalate to strategist
steps.talk: One click sends this to the strategist, with full context attached.

steps.caption: Strategist workspace
steps.talk: This is where the finding turns into an actual recommendation.

steps.caption: Strategist synthesis
steps.talk: Watch the strategist build a recommendation with the reasoning attached — not just a flag, a decision you can act on.

steps.caption: Live relay, no copy-paste
steps.talk: The case is now live on the relay control plane — no email chain, no re-keying data between systems.

steps.caption: Push to executive
steps.talk: One click pushes this straight to the executive portal.

steps.caption: Dollar exposure, live
steps.talk: This is total dollar exposure across the portfolio, updated live — the number a controller actually needs.

steps.caption: Full context inherited
steps.talk: And the executive isn't starting from a blank page — every engine finding and every reasoning step is right here.

cta: TSM catches the coding error or fraud pattern before the payment clears — not in next month's audit.
